info.title: Zoho Analytics API
info.description: API for managing workspaces in Zoho Analytics — covering workspace operations, preferences, domain access, and folder management.

tags.name: Workspace Operations
tags.description: APIs that manage the lifecycle and the metadata of workspaces, covering the creation, copying, renaming, deletion and inspection of a workspace. They also provide the workspace access key used for cross-organization operations, list the workspaces accessible to a user, and export the structure of a workspace as a reusable template.

tags.name: Workspace Preferences
tags.description: APIs that manage the workspace preferences of a user, covering the default workspace that opens on login and the favourite workspaces starred for quick access. Both the preferences are stored per user and per organization, and have no effect on the preferences of any other user.

tags.name: Domain & White Label
tags.description: APIs that control whether a workspace is reachable through the White Label or Client Portal domain of the organization. A workspace is disabled for domain access when it is created and has to be enabled explicitly before the portal users can access it.

tags.name: Workspace Folders
tags.description: APIs that manage the folders of a workspace, covering the creation, renaming, deletion, nesting and reordering of folders, the movement of views between folders, and the selection of the default folder. Folders provide a hierarchical organization layer within a workspace and support exactly one level of nesting.

get.description:
Returns all workspaces accessible to the authenticated user — both workspaces they own or administer, and workspaces shared with them. The response separates owned and shared workspaces into two distinct arrays.

This API is scoped to the user and not to the organization. It returns only the workspaces that the requesting user has some level of access to. Account Admins see all the workspaces of their organization in the owned list.

**Error codes**

| Code | Meaning | Resolution |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 8535 | Invalid or expired OAuth token. | Provide a valid token with scope ZohoAnalytics.metadata.read. |

ownedOnly.description: An Account Admin who owns all the workspaces of the organization and has none shared from other organizations.

ownedAndShared.description: A user who owns a workspace in their own organization and has a workspace from another organization shared with them.

post.description:
Creates a new empty workspace in the specified organisation. The workspace is created with no tables, views, or users — content must be added through subsequent APIs.

**Notes**

> Note:
>
> - The **workspaceName** should be unique within the organization. Creating a workspace with a name that is already in use fails with error code 7111.
> - The **workspaceName** can hold a maximum of 50 characters and the **workspaceDesc** can hold a maximum of 250 characters. Exceeding these limits is rejected during parameter validation.
> - When **workspaceDesc** is omitted, the description is stored as an empty string. It can be updated later using the Rename Workspace API.
> - The response data holds only the **workspaceId**. Use the Get Workspace Info or the Get All Workspace List API to retrieve the complete workspace record.
> - The workspace secret key is not generated at creation time. Use the Get Workspace Secret Key API when the key is needed for a cross-organization copy.
> - The number of workspaces that can be created depends on the subscription plan of the organization. Reaching the limit fails with error code 7951.
> - Organization Admins are allowed to create workspaces within their organization.
> - The workspace is created with no tables or views. The content has to be added using the subsequent APIs.

**Error codes**

| Code | Meaning | Resolution |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 7301 | User is not an Account Admin or Organization Admin. | Ensure the caller has Account Admin or Organization Admin privileges in the target organisation. |
| 7951 | The organisation has reached its workspace creation limit based on the current subscription plan. | Upgrade the plan or delete unused workspaces before creating a new one. |
| 8535 | Invalid or expired OAuth token. | Provide a valid token with scope ZohoAnalytics.modeling.create. |

nameOnly.description: Creates a workspace with a name alone. The description is stored as an empty string.

withDescription.description: Creates a workspace with both a name and a description.

CONFIG.workspaceDesc: Workspace for HR team dashboards and headcount reports

workspaceCreated.description: The ID of the newly created workspace is returned in the data object.

get.description:
Returns all workspaces owned by (created within) the authenticated user's organisation. This is an admin-scoped API — only the Account Admin can call it, and it returns all workspaces in the org regardless of sharing.

**Error codes**

| Code | Meaning | Resolution |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 7301 | User is not the Account Admin. Organization Admins and Workspace Admins cannot call this API. | Use Account Admin credentials. |
| 8535 | Invalid or expired OAuth token. | Provide a valid token with scope ZohoAnalytics.metadata.read. |

multipleWorkspaces.description: The organization holds more than one workspace.

noWorkspaces.description: The organization holds no workspace and an empty array is returned.

get.description:
Returns all workspaces that have been shared with the authenticated user from other organisations. Workspaces in the user's own organisation are not included — use Get All Workspace List to see both owned and shared together.

**Error codes**

| Code | Meaning | Resolution |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 8535 | Invalid or expired OAuth token. | Provide a valid token with scope ZohoAnalytics.metadata.read. |

sharedFromOtherOrg.description: A workspace from another organization is shared with the requesting user.

noSharedWorkspaces.description: No workspace is shared with the requesting user and an empty array is returned.

clientPortalWorkspace.description: A Client Portal or white label user retrieving the workspace of their portal.

get.description:
Returns metadata for the specified workspace. The calling user must have at least some level of access to the workspace (Workspace Admin, or any view in the workspace shared with them). An optional withUserRoleInfo flag enriches the response with the calling user's role details within the workspace.

The optional `withUserRoleInfo` key enriches the response with the role details of the requesting user within the workspace.

**Error codes**

| Code | Meaning | Resolution |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 7103 | Workspace not found. | Verify . |
| 7301 | User does not have any access to the specified workspace. The user must be a workspace admin or have at least one view shared with them in this workspace. | Verify the user has been added to the workspace or has a view shared with them. |
| 8535 | Invalid or expired OAuth token. | Provide a valid token with scope ZohoAnalytics.metadata.read. |

parameters.name: CONFIG
parameters.description: JSONObject that controls the details returned for the workspace. As this is a GET request, the value must be stringified and URL encoded before it is sent.

basicInfo.description: Retrieves the workspace metadata without the role details of the requesting user.

withRoleInfo.description: Retrieves the workspace metadata along with the userRoleInfo object of the requesting user.

basicInfo.description: The workspace metadata alone is returned, as withUserRoleInfo is not set.

workspaces.workspaceDesc: Sales reporting workspace for all regions

accountAdminRole.description: The requesting user is an Account Admin, so roleId is 0 and isCustomRoleUser is false.

workspaces.workspaceDesc: Sales reporting workspace for all regions

customRoleUser.description: The requesting user holds a custom role, so isCustomRoleUser is true and roleId holds the custom role ID.

workspaces.workspaceDesc: Sales reporting workspace for all regions

post.description:
Creates a copy of an existing workspace. The copy can be placed in the same organisation or a different organisation. When copying to a different organisation, the workspace's secret key (workspaceKey) must be provided for authorisation. The copy can optionally include all table data and/or preserve import source connections.

When the destination organization differs from the organization that owns the source workspace, the secret key of the source workspace has to be provided as `workspaceKey` to authorize the copy. The key can be obtained using the Get Workspace Secret Key API. The requesting user should be an Account Admin or an Organization Admin of the destination organization.

> **Rate limit:** Only one copy operation is allowed to run at a time per organization.

**Error codes**

| Code | Meaning | Resolution |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 7103 | Source workspace not found. | Verify of the source workspace. |
| 7301 | User is not an Account Admin or Organization Admin of the destination organisation. | The caller must be an admin of the destination org, not just the source org. |
| 7951 | The destination organisation has reached its workspace limit. | Upgrade the destination org's plan or remove unused workspaces. |
| 8024 | Cross-org copy attempted without a valid workspaceKey, or the provided key does not match the source workspace's secret key. | Obtain the correct workspaceKey from the source workspace owner using Get Workspace Secret Key, then retry. For same-org copies, omit workspaceKey. |
| 8058 | The organisation ID provided in ZANALYTICS-DEST-ORGID does not exist. | Provide a valid, existing organisation ID in ZANALYTICS-DEST-ORGID. |
| 8535 | Invalid or expired OAuth token. | Provide a valid token with scope ZohoAnalytics.modeling.create. |

sameOrgStructureOnly.description: Copies the workspace within the same organization without the table data. The workspaceKey is not required.

sameOrgWithData.description: Copies the workspace within the same organization along with all the table data.

crossOrgAccountAdmin.description: Copies the workspace into another organization as an Account Admin. ZANALYTICS-ORGID holds the destination organization ID and the workspaceKey of the source workspace authorizes the copy.

crossOrgDestHeader.description: Copies the workspace into another organization as an Organization Admin. ZANALYTICS-ORGID holds the source organization ID and ZANALYTICS-DEST-ORGID holds the destination organization ID.

workspaceCopied.description: The ID of the newly created copy is returned in the data object.

put.description:
Updates the name and/or description of an existing workspace. Both fields are replaced atomically — if workspaceDesc is omitted, the description is reset to an empty string (the previous value is not preserved).

**Notes**

> Note:
>
> - Rename Workspace returns a bare HTTP 204 No Content on success. There is no response body and no **status** or **summary** JSON to parse, so check only the HTTP status code. A JSON payload is returned only on failure.
> - When **workspaceDesc** is omitted, the existing description of the workspace is permanently reset to an empty string. Always pass the current description, read using the Get Workspace Info API, when only the name has to be changed.
> - Renaming the workspace to its existing name succeeds without an error.
> - The **workspaceName** should be unique within the organization. Renaming to a name that is already in use fails with error code 7111.
> - The **workspaceName** can hold a maximum of 50 characters and the **workspaceDesc** can hold a maximum of 250 characters. Exceeding these limits is rejected during parameter validation.
> - The name and the description are replaced atomically. Both values in the request overwrite the stored values.

**Error codes**

| Code | Meaning | Resolution |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 7103 | Workspace not found. | Verify . |
| 7111 | The new workspace name is already used by another workspace in the organisation. | Choose a name not already in use. |
| 7301 | User is not an Account Admin or Organization Admin. | Ensure the caller has Account Admin or Org Admin access. |
| 8535 | Invalid or expired OAuth token. | Provide a valid token with scope ZohoAnalytics.modeling.update. |

renameOnly.description: Changes the workspace name alone. As workspaceDesc is omitted, the existing description is cleared.

renameAndDescribe.description: Changes the workspace name and sets a new description in the same request.

CONFIG.workspaceDesc: Consolidated sales reporting for all regions

descriptionOnly.description: Updates the description alone by passing the existing workspace name unchanged.

204.description: Workspace updated successfully. No response body is returned.

delete.description:
Permanently deletes the specified workspace and all of its contents — tables, views, dashboards, formulas, import configurations, and all sharing settings. This operation is irreversible.

**Notes**

> Note:
>
> - Delete Workspace returns a bare HTTP 204 No Content on success. There is no response body and no **status** or **summary** JSON to parse, so check only the HTTP status code. A JSON payload is returned only on failure.
> - The deletion is permanent. There is no trash or recycle mechanism for workspaces, and the workspace along with all its views, data, import configurations and sharing settings cannot be recovered.
> - All the sharing configurations of the workspace are removed. Users who had access to the views in this workspace lose that access at the moment of deletion.
> - The workspace level admin role of the Workspace Admins is removed. Their organization membership and their access to the other workspaces are not affected.
> - Any scheduled or in-progress data import job in the workspace is cancelled.
> - This API accepts an optional CONFIG parameter. No CONFIG key is required for the standard use of this API.

**Error codes**

| Code | Meaning | Resolution |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 7103 | Workspace not found. | Verify . |
| 7301 | User is not an Account Admin or Organization Admin. | Ensure the caller has Account Admin or Org Admin access. |
| 8535 | Invalid or expired OAuth token. | Provide a valid token with scope ZohoAnalytics.modeling.delete. |

204.description: Workspace deleted successfully. No response body is returned.

get.description:
Returns the secret key for the specified workspace. This key is used as the workspaceKey parameter when performing a cross-organisation Copy Workspace operation — it authorises the copying of the workspace to a different organisation.

The key can optionally be regenerated, which permanently invalidates the previous key. The requesting user should be an Account Admin or an Organization Admin of the organization that owns the workspace.

**Notes**

> Note:
>
> - Setting **regenerateKey** to false, which is the default, is safe to invoke repeatedly. The existing key is returned each time, and a key is generated on the first call when none exists.
> - Setting **regenerateKey** to true invalidates the previous key immediately. A cross-organization copy attempted with the old key after regeneration fails with error code 8024. A copy operation that had already started before the regeneration is not affected, as the key is validated only at the start of the copy.
> - The workspace secret key is returned only by this API. It is not present in the response of the Get Workspace Info, the Get All Workspace List or any other API.
> - Only the Account Admins and the Organization Admins of the organization that owns the workspace can retrieve the key.
> - As this is a GET request, the CONFIG value should be stringified and URL encoded before it is sent.

**Error codes**

| Code | Meaning | Resolution |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 7103 | Workspace not found. | Verify . |
| 7301 | User is not an Account Admin or Organization Admin. | Ensure the caller has Account Admin or Org Admin access. |
| 8535 | Invalid or expired OAuth token. | Provide a valid token with scope ZohoAnalytics.metadata.read. |

parameters.name: CONFIG
parameters.description: JSONObject that controls whether the workspace secret key has to be regenerated. As this is a GET request, the value must be stringified and URL encoded before it is sent.

existingKey.description: Retrieves the existing secret key of the workspace without modifying it.

regenerateKey.description: Generates a new secret key, stores it against the workspace and returns it. The previous key is invalidated.

secretKeyReturned.description: The current secret key of the workspace is returned in the data object.

get.description:
Exports selected views from the specified workspace as a reusable template file. The response is a binary file in .atpt (Zoho Analytics Template) format — not a JSON payload. This file can be imported into another workspace to recreate the selected views and their structural dependencies.

The template holds the schema definitions of the selected tables and views, the formula and lookup columns, the calculated fields and the view design configurations. The data rows of the source tables are not exported.

**Error codes**

| Code | Meaning | Resolution |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 7103 | Workspace not found. | Verify . |
| 7104 | One or more specified view IDs do not exist. | Verify all viewIds are valid using the Get View List API. |
| 7319 | One or more specified view IDs do not belong to the specified workspace. | Ensure all viewIds belong to the workspace identified by . |
| 7301 | User is not a Workspace Admin, Account Admin, or Organization Admin. | Ensure the caller has at least Workspace Admin access. |
| 8535 | Invalid or expired OAuth token. | Provide a valid token with scope ZohoAnalytics.metadata.read. |

parameters.name: CONFIG
parameters.description: JSONObject that holds the IDs of the views to be exported and the name of the template file. As this is a GET request, the value must be stringified and URL encoded before it is sent.

selectedViews.description: Exports two specific views as a template using the system generated file name.

customFileName.description: Exports three views as a template and names the exported file explicitly.

200.description: Binary .atpt template file returned as an attachment.

Content-Disposition.description: Holds the name of the exported template file, for example attachment; filename="SalesAnalytics_Q3_Template.atpt".

schema.description: The exported template as a binary .atpt file.

post.description:
Marks the specified workspace as the calling user's default workspace. The default workspace is the one that opens automatically when the user logs in to Zoho Analytics.

A user can hold only one default workspace at a time. When a different workspace is already set as the default, it is replaced silently. Invoking this API on a workspace that is already the default succeeds without error.

**Notes**

> Note:
>
> - Add Default Workspace returns a bare HTTP 204 No Content on success. There is no response body and no **status** or **summary** JSON to parse, so check only the HTTP status code. A JSON payload is returned only on failure.
> - A user can hold only one default workspace at a time. When the user already holds a different workspace as the default, the previous default is replaced silently and no error is raised.
> - This API is idempotent. Invoking it on a workspace that is already the default workspace of the user succeeds without error and makes no change.
> - The requesting user should have at least one view of the workspace shared with them. A user with no access to any view of the workspace cannot mark it as the default workspace and the request fails with error code 7301.
> - The default preference continues to be stored even when the user loses access to the workspace later. However, the workspace is not presented as accessible until the access is restored.
> - After this API is invoked, the workspace is returned with isDefault as true in the response of the Get All Workspace List and the Get Shared Workspace List APIs. Use those APIs to verify the change.
> - The preferences are stored per user and per organization. Marking a workspace as the default for one user has no effect on the preferences of any other user.
> - Client Portal users and standard Zoho Analytics users maintain separate preference stores, even when they access the same workspace. A Client Portal user should access the workspace through the portal domain in which it is shared with them, failing which the access check fails with error code 7301.

**Error codes**

| Code | Meaning | Resolution |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 7103 | Workspace not found. | Verify . |
| 7301 | The user has no access to the specified workspace — no views have been shared with them, and they are not a Workspace Admin. | Ensure the user is a workspace member or has at least one view shared with them before marking it as default. |
| 8535 | Invalid or expired OAuth token. | Provide a valid token with scope ZohoAnalytics.metadata.update. |

204.description: Workspace marked as the default workspace successfully. No response body is returned.

delete.description:
Removes the default workspace designation from the specified workspace for the calling user. After this operation, the user has no default workspace set.

Unlike the Add Default Workspace API, this API is not idempotent. When the specified workspace is not the current default workspace of the user, the request fails with error code 7415. Verify the current default using the Get All Workspace List API, which returns `isDefault` as true for the current default, before invoking this API.

**Notes**

> Note:
>
> - Remove Default Workspace returns a bare HTTP 204 No Content on success. There is no response body and no **status** or **summary** JSON to parse, so check only the HTTP status code. A JSON payload is returned only on failure.
> - This API is not idempotent. When the specified workspace is not the current default workspace of the requesting user, the request fails with error code 7415 instead of succeeding silently.
> - Use the Get All Workspace List API to confirm that the target workspace holds isDefault as true before invoking this API.
> - This behaviour differs from the Add Default Workspace API, which is idempotent, and from the Remove Favourite Workspace API, which succeeds silently when the workspace is not in the favourites.
> - After the designation is removed, the user holds no default workspace. A new default has to be set explicitly using the Add Default Workspace API.
> - Invoking this API immediately after the Add Default Workspace API succeeds, as the workspace can be set and unset in sequence.
> - The requesting user should have at least one view of the workspace shared with them, failing which the request fails with error code 7301.
> - The preferences are stored per user and per organization. Removing the default designation for one user has no effect on the preferences of any other user.

**Error codes**

| Code | Meaning | Resolution |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 7103 | Workspace not found. | Verify . |
| 7301 | The user has no access to the specified workspace. | Ensure the user has at least one view shared with them in the workspace. |
| 7415 | The specified workspace is not the calling user's current default workspace. This API does not succeed silently for non-default workspaces. | Use Get All Workspace List to identify the workspace with isDefault: true, then call this API with that workspace ID. |
| 8535 | Invalid or expired OAuth token. | Provide a valid token with scope ZohoAnalytics.metadata.update. |

204.description: Default workspace designation removed successfully. No response body is returned.

post.description:
Adds the specified workspace to the calling user's list of favourite workspaces. Favourited workspaces are typically surfaced at the top of workspace listings for quick navigation.

A user can mark any number of workspaces as favourite, as there is no exclusivity constraint. When the workspace is already present in the favourites, the request succeeds silently without error.

**Notes**

> Note:
>
> - Add Favourite Workspace returns a bare HTTP 204 No Content on success. There is no response body and no **status** or **summary** JSON to parse, so check only the HTTP status code. A JSON payload is returned only on failure.
> - This API is idempotent. When the workspace is already present in the favourites of the user, the request succeeds without error and no duplicate entry is created.
> - There is no limit on the number of workspaces a user can mark as favourite. Unlike the default workspace, the favourite preference carries no exclusivity constraint.
> - The requesting user should have at least one view of the workspace shared with them. Access is checked at the workspace level and no permission beyond basic read access is required. A user with no access fails with error code 7301.
> - The favourite preference is not exposed as a distinct field in the response of the standard workspace list APIs.
> - The preferences are stored per user and per organization. Adding a workspace to the favourites of one user has no effect on the preferences of any other user.
> - Client Portal users and standard Zoho Analytics users maintain separate preference stores, even when they access the same workspace. A Client Portal user should access the workspace through the portal domain in which it is shared with them, failing which the access check fails with error code 7301.

**Error codes**

| Code | Meaning | Resolution |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 7103 | Workspace not found. | Verify . |
| 7301 | The user has no access to the specified workspace. | Ensure the user is a workspace member or has at least one view shared with them before adding it to favourites. |
| 8535 | Invalid or expired OAuth token. | Provide a valid token with scope ZohoAnalytics.metadata.update. |

204.description: Workspace added to the favourites successfully. No response body is returned.

delete.description:
Removes the specified workspace from the calling user's list of favourite workspaces. If the workspace is not currently in the user's favourites, this call succeeds silently without error (idempotent).

This API is idempotent. When the workspace is not present in the favourites of the user, the request succeeds silently without error. This differs from the Remove Default Workspace API, which fails with error code 7415 in the equivalent situation.

**Notes**

> Note:
>
> - Remove Favourite Workspace returns a bare HTTP 204 No Content on success. There is no response body and no **status** or **summary** JSON to parse, so check only the HTTP status code. A JSON payload is returned only on failure.
> - This API is idempotent. When the workspace is not present in the favourites of the user, the request succeeds silently without error.
> - This behaviour differs from the Remove Default Workspace API, which fails with error code 7415 when the workspace is not the current default. This is the key behavioural difference between the two remove operations.
> - The requesting user should have at least one view of the workspace shared with them, failing which the request fails with error code 7301.
> - The preferences are stored per user and per organization. Removing a workspace from the favourites of one user has no effect on the preferences of any other user.

**Error codes**

| Code | Meaning | Resolution |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 7103 | Workspace not found. | Verify . |
| 7301 | The user has no access to the specified workspace. | Ensure the user has at least one view shared with them in the workspace. |
| 8535 | Invalid or expired OAuth token. | Provide a valid token with scope ZohoAnalytics.metadata.update. |

204.description: Workspace removed from the favourites successfully. No response body is returned.

post.description:
Enables the specified workspace for access through the organisation's White Label / Client Portal domain. Once enabled, the workspace becomes visible and accessible to users who log in via the configured custom domain URL.

The portal domain is resolved automatically from the White Label configuration of the Account Admin of the workspace, so no domain name parameter is required. Invoking this API on a workspace that is already enabled for domain access fails with error code 12049.

**Error codes**

| Code | Meaning | Resolution |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 7103 | Workspace not found. | Verify . |
| 7301 | The caller is not an Account Admin or Organization Admin of the workspace's organisation, or the workspace's Account Admin does not have a White Label / Client Portal domain configured. | Ensure the caller is an org admin and that the organisation has an active White Label domain setup. |
| 12049 | The workspace is already enabled for White Label domain access. Calling Enable on an already-enabled workspace is not idempotent. | Check the current domain access state before calling. Use Disable first if you need to re-enable (e.g., after domain reconfiguration). |
| 8535 | Invalid or expired OAuth token. | Provide a valid token with scope ZohoAnalytics.metadata.update. |

204.description: Workspace enabled for domain access successfully. No response body is returned.

delete.description:
Removes the specified workspace from the organisation's White Label / Client Portal domain. Once disabled, the workspace is no longer accessible to users who log in via the custom portal domain URL. Users who had access via the portal immediately lose that access.

Disabling gates only the access through the portal domain. It does not remove any view level sharing or user membership, and the workspace remains fully accessible through the standard Zoho Analytics URL for the non-portal users. Invoking this API on a workspace that is not currently enabled for domain access fails with error code 12050.

**Error codes**

| Code | Meaning | Resolution |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 7103 | Workspace not found. | Verify . |
| 7301 | The caller is not an Account Admin or Organization Admin of the workspace's organisation, or the organisation has no White Label domain. | Ensure the caller has admin access and the org has a configured White Label domain. |
| 12050 | The workspace is not currently enabled for White Label domain access. Calling Disable on an already-disabled workspace is not idempotent. | Verify the current state before calling. Only call Disable on workspaces previously enabled via Enable Workspace for Domain Access. |
| 8535 | Invalid or expired OAuth token. | Provide a valid token with scope ZohoAnalytics.metadata.update. |

204.description: Workspace disabled for domain access successfully. No response body is returned.

get.description:
Returns all folders in the specified workspace, including their names, descriptions, display order, default status, and parent folder references. Shared users and group members receive a filtered list containing only the folders that include at least one view they have access to.

Workspace Admins receive every folder of the workspace. Shared users and group members receive a filtered list holding only the folders that contain at least one view they have access to.

**Error codes**

| Code | Meaning | Resolution |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 7301 | User does not have permission. | Ensure the user is a Workspace Admin, or has at least READ access to one or more views in the workspace. |

nestedFolders.description: A Workspace Admin retrieving a workspace that holds the default folder along with two root level folders and their sub-folders.

filteredForSharedUser.description: A shared user retrieving the same workspace. Only the folders holding a view accessible to them are returned, along with the parent of the accessible sub-folder.

defaultFolderOnly.description: A workspace that holds no folder other than the default folder created along with it.

post.description:
Creates a new folder in the specified workspace. The folder can optionally be created as a sub-folder of an existing root level folder, and can be set as the default folder of the workspace at the time of creation.

**Error codes**

| Code | Meaning | Resolution |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 7140 | A folder with the same name already exists in the workspace. | Use a unique folder name within the workspace. |
| 7144 | The specified parentFolderId does not exist. | Verify the parentFolderId value using the Get Folder List API. |
| 7301 | User does not have permission. | Ensure the user is a Workspace Admin or has Create Folder permission on the workspace. |
| 7414 | Folder name cannot be empty. | Provide a non-empty value for folderName. |
| 7496 | Maximum subfolder nesting depth exceeded. | Sub-folders cannot themselves have children. Only one level of nesting is supported. |

rootFolder.description: Creates a folder at the root level of the workspace, as parentFolderId is not sent.

subFolder.description: Creates a folder nested under an existing root level folder.

defaultFolder.description: Creates a root level folder and sets it as the default folder of the workspace in the same request.

folderCreated.description: The ID of the newly created folder is returned in the data object.

put.description:
Updates the name and/or description of an existing folder. If folderDesc is omitted from the request, the folder's existing description is reset to an empty string.

**Notes**

> Note:
>
> - Rename Folder returns a bare HTTP 204 No Content on success. There is no response body and no **status** or **summary** JSON to parse, so check only the HTTP status code. A JSON payload is returned only on failure.
> - When folderDesc is omitted, the existing description of the folder is permanently reset to an empty string. This is intentional behaviour and not a defect. Always read the current folderDesc using the Get Folder List API and pass it back when only the name has to be changed.
> - Renaming the folder to its existing name succeeds without an error.
> - The folderName should be unique within the workspace. Renaming to a name that is already in use fails with error code 7140, and an empty name fails with error code 7414.
> - The folderName can hold a maximum of 200 characters and the folderDesc can hold a maximum of 250 characters.
> - The folder-id in the request URL should be obtained using the Get Folder List API.

**Error codes**

| Code | Meaning | Resolution |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 7140 | A folder with the same name already exists in the workspace. | Use a unique folder name within the workspace. |
| 7144 | The specified folder does not exist. | Verify the folder ID using the Get Folder List API. |
| 7301 | User does not have permission. | Ensure the user is a Workspace Admin or has Create Folder permission on the workspace. |
| 7414 | Folder name cannot be empty. | Provide a non-empty value for folderName. |

preserveDescription.description: Changes the folder name while passing back the existing description, read using the Get Folder List API, so that it is not cleared.

updateDescription.description: Changes the folder name and sets a new description in the same request.

204.description: Folder updated successfully. No response body is returned.

delete.description:
Deletes the specified folder from the workspace. By default the views present inside the folder are retained and moved to the root level of the workspace, and only the folder container is removed. The views can optionally be deleted along with the folder.

**Error codes**

| Code | Meaning | Resolution |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 7144 | The specified folder does not exist. | Verify the folder ID using the Get Folder List API. |
| 7277 | The folder contains tables that have dependent child views; deletion blocked. | Set deleteDependentViews to true to delete the folder along with all dependent views, or manually delete the dependent views first. |
| 7301 | User does not have permission. | Ensure the user is a Workspace Admin or has Create Folder permission on the workspace. |

retainViews.description: Deletes the folder container alone. The views present inside it are moved to the root level of the workspace.

deleteViews.description: Deletes the folder along with all the views present inside it, including the tables and their dependent reports and dashboards.

204.description: Folder deleted successfully. No response body is returned.

put.description:
Sets the specified folder as the default folder for the workspace. The previous default folder (if any) loses its default status. Every workspace has exactly one default folder at all times.

This API is idempotent. Invoking it on a folder that is already the default folder succeeds without error.

**Notes**

> Note:
>
> - Make Default Folder returns a bare HTTP 204 No Content on success. There is no response body and no **status** or **summary** JSON to parse, so check only the HTTP status code. A JSON payload is returned only on failure.
> - The folder that was the default until then immediately loses its isDefault status. A workspace holds exactly one default folder at any point in time.
> - This API is idempotent. Invoking it on a folder that is already the default folder succeeds without error and makes no change.
> - Use the Get Folder List API after invoking this API to confirm that isDefault is true on the intended folder.
> - The folder-id in the request URL should be obtained using the Get Folder List API.

**Error codes**

| Code | Meaning | Resolution |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 7144 | The specified folder does not exist. | Verify the folder ID using the Get Folder List API. |
| 7301 | User does not have permission. | Ensure the user is a Workspace Admin or has Create Folder permission on the workspace. |

204.description: Default folder set successfully. No response body is returned.

put.description:
Changes the hierarchical position of a folder — either promoting a sub-folder to a top-level folder, or nesting an existing top-level folder under another top-level folder.

**Notes**

> Note:
>
> - Change Folder Hierarchy returns a bare HTTP 204 No Content on success. There is no response body and no **status** or **summary** JSON to parse, so check only the HTTP status code. A JSON payload is returned only on failure.
> - When hierarchy is set to 0, the parentFolderId should not be sent. The parent link of the folder is removed and it becomes a root level folder.
> - When hierarchy is set to 1, the parentFolderId is mandatory. Omitting it results in an error.
> - The parentFolderId should refer to a root level folder, that is, a folder whose own parentFolderId is -1. A folder cannot be nested inside an existing sub-folder, as exactly one level of nesting is supported.
> - Only the values 0 and 1 are accepted for hierarchy. Any other value fails with error code 8119 before any change is made.
> - Both the folder-id in the request URL and the parentFolderId should be obtained using the Get Folder List API. Verify that the parentFolderId target is a root level folder before invoking this API.

**Error codes**

| Code | Meaning | Resolution |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 7144 | The specified folder or parent folder does not exist. | Verify the folder IDs using the Get Folder List API. |
| 7301 | User does not have permission. | Ensure the user is a Workspace Admin or has Create Folder permission on the workspace. |
| 8119 | Invalid value for hierarchy. Only 0 and 1 are accepted. | Use 0 to promote a sub-folder to root level, or 1 to nest a folder under a parent. |

promoteToRoot.description: Promotes the specified sub-folder to become a root level folder. The parentFolderId is not sent.

nestUnderParent.description: Nests the specified root level folder under another root level folder given in parentFolderId.

204.description: Folder hierarchy changed successfully. No response body is returned.

put.description:
Reorders a folder by moving it to just above another specified folder at the same hierarchy level. Both folders must be at the same level (both top-level or both sub-folders of the same parent).

**Notes**

> Note:
>
> - Change Folder Position returns a bare HTTP 204 No Content on success. There is no response body and no **status** or **summary** JSON to parse, so check only the HTTP status code. A JSON payload is returned only on failure.
> - The folder identified by the folder-id in the request URL is placed immediately above the folder given in referenceFolderId in the sorted list.
> - Both the folders should be at the same hierarchy level, that is, both at the root level or both sub-folders of the same parent. Reordering across levels is not supported and produces unexpected results.
> - The folderIndex values of the affected folders are recalculated after this operation. Use the Get Folder List API to confirm the new ordering.
> - Both the folder-id in the request URL and the referenceFolderId should be obtained using the Get Folder List API.

**Error codes**

| Code | Meaning | Resolution |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 7144 | The specified folder or reference folder does not exist. | Verify the folder IDs using the Get Folder List API. |
| 7301 | User does not have permission. | Ensure the user is a Workspace Admin or has Create Folder permission on the workspace. |

reorderRootFolder.description: Places the specified root level folder immediately above another root level folder.

reorderSubFolder.description: Places the specified sub-folder immediately above another sub-folder of the same parent.

204.description: Folder position changed successfully. No response body is returned.

put.description:
Moves one or more views (tables, reports, dashboards) into the specified destination folder within the workspace. All views must belong to the same workspace. Up to 1000 view IDs can be moved in a single request.

The operation is transactional. A single view ID that does not belong to the workspace fails the entire request before any view is moved.

**Error codes**

| Code | Meaning | Resolution |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 7144 | The specified destination folder does not exist. | Verify the folderId using the Get Folder List API. |
| 7301 | User does not have permission. | Ensure the user is a Workspace Admin or has Create Folder permission on the workspace. |
| 7319 | One or more view IDs do not belong to the specified workspace. | Ensure all view IDs in viewIds belong to the workspace identified by . |

singleView.description: Moves one view into the destination folder.

bulkViews.description: Moves several views into the destination folder in one request.

204.description: Views moved successfully. No response body is returned.

org-id.name: ZANALYTICS-ORGID
org-id.description: The ID of the organization in which the operation has to be performed. It can be obtained using the Get Organizations API.

workspace-id.name: workspace-id
workspace-id.description: The ID of the workspace. It can be obtained using any of the workspace list APIs.

folder-id.name: folder-id
folder-id.description: The ID of the folder. It can be obtained using the Get Folder List API.

org-id-optional.name: ZANALYTICS-ORGID
org-id-optional.description: The ID of the organization. This header is not required for this API, as the scope of the request is resolved from the requesting user. It can be obtained using the Get Organizations API.

dest-org-id.name: ZANALYTICS-DEST-ORGID
dest-org-id.description: The ID of the destination organization into which the workspace has to be copied. It is used by Organization Admins who have admin access in more than one organization. When this header is present, the system validates that the requesting user is a member of the specified organization and uses it as the target of the copy. When it is absent, the destination organization defaults to the organization resolved from the ZANALYTICS-ORGID header.

CreateWorkspaceConfig.title: CreateWorkspaceConfig
CreateWorkspaceConfig.description: JSONObject that holds the details of the workspace to be created.

workspaceName.description: The name for the new workspace. It should be unique within the organization and can hold a maximum of 50 characters.

workspaceDesc.description: The description of the workspace. It can hold a maximum of 250 characters.

CreateWorkspaceResponse.title: CreateWorkspaceResponse
CreateWorkspaceResponse.description: JSONObject returned on successfully creating the workspace.

summary.description: A short summary of the operation performed. It holds the value Create workspace.

data.description: JSONObject that holds the ID of the newly created workspace.

workspaceId.description: The unique ID of the newly created workspace. Use this value as the workspace-id in all the subsequent workspace specific API calls.

CopyWorkspaceConfig.title: CopyWorkspaceConfig
CopyWorkspaceConfig.description: JSONObject that holds the details of the workspace copy to be created.

newWorkspaceName.description: The name for the copied workspace. It should be unique within the destination organization and can hold a maximum of 50 characters.

newWorkspaceDesc.description: The description for the copied workspace. It can hold a maximum of 250 characters. The description of the source workspace is not carried over automatically.

workspaceKey.description: The secret key of the source workspace, obtained using the Get Workspace Secret Key API. It is mandatory when the destination organization differs from the organization that owns the source workspace, and is not validated for copies within the same organization.

copyWithData.description:
Controls whether the data rows in the tables have to be copied along with the workspace structure.

- **true** - Copies the complete workspace, including all the table data.
- **false** - Copies only the workspace structure, such as the table schema, views, formulas and dashboards.

copyWithImportSource.description:
Controls whether the import source connections have to be retained in the copied workspace.

- **true** - Retains the import source configurations, such as the cloud storage connections and the database connectors.
- **false** - Copies the tables without any import source. The data has to be re-imported into the copied workspace.

CopyWorkspaceResponse.title: CopyWorkspaceResponse
CopyWorkspaceResponse.description: JSONObject returned on successfully copying the workspace.

summary.description: A short summary of the operation performed. It holds the value Copy workspace.

data.description: JSONObject that holds the ID of the newly created copy.

workspaceId.description: The unique ID of the workspace copy that was created. Use this value as the workspace-id in the subsequent API calls.

RenameWorkspaceConfig.title: RenameWorkspaceConfig
RenameWorkspaceConfig.description: JSONObject that holds the new name and description of the workspace.

workspaceName.description: The new name for the workspace. It should be unique within the organization and can hold a maximum of 50 characters.

workspaceDesc.description: The new description for the workspace. It can hold a maximum of 250 characters. When this key is omitted, the existing description is reset to an empty string.

ExportTemplateConfig.title: ExportTemplateConfig
ExportTemplateConfig.description: JSONObject that holds the details of the template to be exported.

fileName.description: The name for the exported template file, given without the file extension. When this key is omitted, the file name is generated from the workspace name.

TemplateViewIds.title: TemplateViewIds
TemplateViewIds.description: JSONArray that holds the IDs of the views to be included in the template. It should hold a minimum of one view ID and a maximum of 1000 view IDs.

items.description: ID of a view to be exported. It should belong to the workspace specified in the request URL.

GetAllWorkspacesResponse.title: GetAllWorkspacesResponse
GetAllWorkspacesResponse.description: JSONObject that holds the workspaces owned by and shared with the requesting user.

summary.description: A short summary of the operation performed. It holds the value Get all workspaces.

data.description: JSONObject that holds the owned and the shared workspace lists.

GetOwnedWorkspacesResponse.title: GetOwnedWorkspacesResponse
GetOwnedWorkspacesResponse.description: JSONObject that holds all the workspaces present in the organization of the requesting Account Admin.

summary.description: A short summary of the operation performed. It holds the value Get owned workspaces.

data.description: JSONObject that holds the owned workspace list.

GetSharedWorkspacesResponse.title: GetSharedWorkspacesResponse
GetSharedWorkspacesResponse.description: JSONObject that holds the workspaces shared with the requesting user from other organizations.

summary.description: A short summary of the operation performed. It holds the value Get shared workspaces.

data.description: JSONObject that holds the shared workspace list.

WorkspaceList.title: WorkspaceList
WorkspaceList.description: JSONArray that holds the workspace records. It holds an empty array when no workspace matches the request.

WorkspaceSummary.title: WorkspaceSummary
WorkspaceSummary.description: JSONObject that holds the summary details of a workspace.

workspaceId.description: The unique ID of the workspace.

workspaceName.description: The display name of the workspace.

workspaceDesc.description: The description of the workspace. It holds an empty string when the description is not set.

orgId.description: The ID of the organization that owns the workspace.

createdTime.description: The time at which the workspace was created, given as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

createdBy.description: The email address of the user who created the workspace.

isDefault.description: Indicates whether the workspace is the default workspace of the organization.

GetWorkspaceSecretKeyConfig.title: GetWorkspaceSecretKeyConfig
GetWorkspaceSecretKeyConfig.description: JSONObject that controls whether the workspace secret key has to be regenerated.

regenerateKey.description:
Controls whether a new secret key has to be generated for the workspace.

- **true** - Generates a new secret key, stores it as the workspace secret key and returns it. The previous key is permanently invalidated.
- **false** - Returns the existing secret key without modifying it.

GetWorkspaceSecretKeyResponse.title: GetWorkspaceSecretKeyResponse
GetWorkspaceSecretKeyResponse.description: JSONObject that holds the secret key of the specified workspace.

summary.description: A short summary of the operation performed. It holds the value Get workspace secretkey.

data.description: JSONObject that holds the workspace secret key.

workspaceKey.description: The current secret key of the workspace, given as a hexadecimal string. Pass this value as the workspaceKey in the Copy Workspace CONFIG while copying the workspace to a different organization.

GetWorkspaceInfoConfig.title: GetWorkspaceInfoConfig
GetWorkspaceInfoConfig.description: JSONObject that controls the details returned for the workspace.

withUserRoleInfo.description:
Controls whether the role details of the requesting user have to be included in the response.

- **true** - Includes the userRoleInfo object, which holds the role name, the role ID and the custom role indicator of the requesting user.
- **false** - Returns the workspace metadata alone.

GetWorkspaceDetailsResponse.title: GetWorkspaceDetailsResponse
GetWorkspaceDetailsResponse.description: JSONObject that holds the metadata of the specified workspace.

summary.description: A short summary of the operation performed. It holds the value Get workspace details.

data.description: JSONObject that holds the workspace metadata.

workspaces.workspaceDesc: Sales reporting workspace for all regions

WorkspaceInfo.title: WorkspaceInfo
WorkspaceInfo.description: JSONObject that holds the metadata of a single workspace.

workspaceId.description: The unique ID of the workspace.

workspaceName.description: The display name of the workspace.

workspaceDesc.description: The description of the workspace. It holds an empty string when the description is not set.

createdTime.description: The time at which the workspace was created, given as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

createdBy.description: The email address of the user who created the workspace.

orgId.description: The ID of the organization that owns the workspace.

examples.workspaceDesc: Sales reporting workspace for all regions

WorkspaceUserRoleInfo.title: WorkspaceUserRoleInfo
WorkspaceUserRoleInfo.description: JSONObject that holds the role details of the requesting user within the workspace. It is returned only when withUserRoleInfo is set to true.

isCustomRoleUser.description: Indicates whether the requesting user is assigned a custom role in the workspace.

roleId.description: The numeric ID of the role held by the requesting user. It is 0 for the standard organization roles such as Account Admin and Organization Admin, and holds the custom role ID for custom role users.

roleName.description: The display name of the role held by the requesting user, such as Account Admin, Organization Admin, Workspace Admin, User, Viewer, or the name of a custom role.

GetFoldersResponse.title: GetFoldersResponse
GetFoldersResponse.description: JSONObject that holds the folders present in the specified workspace.

summary.description: A short summary of the operation performed. It holds the value Get folders.

data.description: JSONObject that holds the folder list.

FolderList.title: FolderList
FolderList.description: JSONArray that holds the folders present in the workspace. It holds an empty array when the requesting user has access to no view in the workspace.

FolderDetails.title: FolderDetails
FolderDetails.description: JSONObject that holds the details of a folder present in the workspace.

folderId.description: The unique ID of the folder.

folderName.description: The display name of the folder.

folderDesc.description: The description of the folder. It holds an empty string when the description is not set.

folderIndex.description: The sort position of the folder within its hierarchy level. The default folder always holds -1, and the remaining folders are sorted in the ascending order of this value.

isDefault.description: Indicates whether the folder is the current default folder of the workspace. Exactly one folder of a workspace holds true at any point in time.

parentFolderId.description: The ID of the parent folder, returned as a string. It holds -1 when the folder is at the root level and has no parent.

CreateFolderConfig.title: CreateFolderConfig
CreateFolderConfig.description: JSONObject that holds the details of the folder to be created.

folderName.description: The name for the new folder. It should be unique within the workspace and can hold a maximum of 200 characters.

folderDesc.description: The description of the folder. It can hold a maximum of 250 characters.

parentFolderId.description: The ID of an existing root level folder under which this folder has to be created. Pass -1 or omit this key to create the folder at the root level.

makeDefaultFolder.description:
Controls whether the newly created folder has to be set as the default folder of the workspace.

- **true** - Sets the new folder as the default folder. The folder that was the default until then loses that status.
- **false** - Creates the folder without changing the current default folder.

CreateFolderResponse.title: CreateFolderResponse
CreateFolderResponse.description: JSONObject returned on successfully creating the folder.

summary.description: A short summary of the operation performed. It holds the value Folder has been created successfully..

data.description: JSONObject that holds the ID of the newly created folder.

folderId.description: The unique ID of the newly created folder. Use the Get Folder List API to retrieve the complete folder record.

RenameFolderConfig.title: RenameFolderConfig
RenameFolderConfig.description: JSONObject that holds the new name and description of the folder.

folderName.description: The new name for the folder. It should be unique within the workspace and can hold a maximum of 200 characters.

folderDesc.description: The new description for the folder. It can hold a maximum of 250 characters. When this key is omitted, the existing description is reset to an empty string.

DeleteFolderConfig.title: DeleteFolderConfig
DeleteFolderConfig.description: JSONObject that controls whether the views present inside the folder have to be deleted along with the folder.

deleteDependentViews.description:
Controls the handling of the views present inside the folder.

- **true** - Permanently deletes all the views present inside the folder, including the tables and their dependent reports and dashboards.
- **false** - Deletes the folder alone and retains the views by moving them to the root level of the workspace. The request fails with error code 7277 when the folder holds a table that has dependent views.

ChangeFolderHierarchyConfig.title: ChangeFolderHierarchyConfig
ChangeFolderHierarchyConfig.description: JSONObject that holds the details of the hierarchy change to be applied to the folder.

hierarchy.description:
Controls the direction of the hierarchy change.

- **0** - Promotes the specified sub-folder to become a root level folder. The `parentFolderId` key should not be sent.
- **1** - Nests the specified root level folder under the folder given in `parentFolderId`. The `parentFolderId` key is mandatory.

parentFolderId.description: The ID of the root level folder that has to become the parent. It is mandatory when hierarchy is set to 1, and should not be sent when hierarchy is set to 0.

ChangeFolderPositionConfig.title: ChangeFolderPositionConfig
ChangeFolderPositionConfig.description: JSONObject that holds the position anchor for the folder to be reordered.

referenceFolderId.description: The ID of the folder immediately above which the specified folder has to be placed. It should be at the same hierarchy level as the folder being reordered.

MoveViewsToFolderConfig.title: MoveViewsToFolderConfig
MoveViewsToFolderConfig.description: JSONObject that holds the destination folder and the views to be moved into it.

folderId.description: The ID of the destination folder. It can be a root level folder or a sub-folder.

MoveViewIds.title: MoveViewIds
MoveViewIds.description: JSONArray that holds the IDs of the views to be moved into the destination folder. It can hold a maximum of 1000 view IDs.

items.description: ID of a view to be moved. It should belong to the workspace specified in the request URL.
